description_en: The initial construction of the Bhāgeśvara Temple began in 1828 CE (NS 948) under the initiative of a person named Bhājurāma. He also commissioned the construction of acaugharāsataḥ(rest house with rooms) encircling the Bhāgeśvara Temple on the same date. Bhājurāma commissioned the construction of the Temple andsataḥto absolve him from the sins committed by his body, speech, and sensory organs. The construction of the Temple with avānaliṅgaenshrined inside the sanctum was completed in 1831 CE (NS 951). In 1834 (NS 954), he endowed many plots of land for performing the daily rituals at the Temple, observing its anniversary, performing a fire oblation along with lighting amahādīpaon the day ofŚivarātrī, caretaking thecaugharāsataḥ, and also for offeringpiṇḍa(ritual cooked rice-ball) after his death. Unfortunately, the Temple possesses no land property for decades. The endowed plots of land were, most probably, fraudulently transferred to individual(s) due course of time. This considerably decreased the income of the Temple, which, in turn, interrupted the performance of the above-mentioned rituals.
description_ne: साँखुको महादेवस्थानमा रहेको महादेव पोखरीको उत्तरमा भागेश्वर महादेवको मन्दिर रहेको छ । गुम्बज शैलीको यो मन्दिर भाजुरामले नेसं ९४८ (सन् १८२८) मा बनाउन शुरु गरेका थिए । मन्दिर निर्माणसँगै मन्दिरको चारैतिर चौघरा सतःको निर्माण कार्य पनि शुरु गरिएको थियो । उनले शरीर, वचन र दश इन्द्रियले गरेका पापको मोचन होस् भन्ने कामना गरी मन्दिर निर्माण गर्न शुरु गरेका थिए । नेसं ९५१ (सन् १८३१) मा मन्दिरको निर्माण कार्य सम्पन्न गरी वानलिङ्गलाई मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा स्थापना गरेका थिए । मन्दिरको निर्माण सम्पन्न गरी फलामको त्रिशूल पनि चढाएका थिए । नेसं ९५४ (सन् १८३४) मा मन्दिरको नित्यपूजा गर्न, वर्षवर्द्धनपूजा गर्न, शिवरात्रीमा यज्ञ गरी महादीप बाल्न, आफ्नो मृत्युपछि पिण्डदान गर्न, चौघरा सतःको हेरविचार गर्न धेरै जग्गा राखिदिएका थिए । समय बित्दै जाँदा ती जग्गाहरू पनि मासिएर गए । फलस्वरूप मन्दिरको आयस्ता घट्न थाल्यो । मन्दिरको हेरचाह, नित्यपूजा लगायत अन्य पूजाहरू पनि प्रभावित हुन थाले । केही समय अघिसम्म भट्ट ब्राह्मणले नित्यपूजा चलाइरहेका थिए । उनको मृत्युपछि उनकी छोरीले पनि केही समय नित्यपूजा चलाइन् । त्यसपछि एकजना सूर्य बाजे भनिने उपाध्याय ब्राह्मणलाई नित्यपूजा गर्ने जिम्मेवारी दिइएको थियो । तर उनको काम चित्त नबुझेकोले हटाइएको थियो । अहिले मन्दिरमा कोही पनि पूजारी छैनन् । मन्दिरको रेखदेख गर्न राखिएका रामकृष्ण सिंहले नै साधारण रूपले मन्दिरको पूजा गरिरहेका छन् । प्रत्येक वर्ष शिवरात्रीमा मन्दिर प्राङ्गनमा यज्ञ गरिन्छ र बेलुकी आगो बालिन्छ । प्रत्येक वर्ष माघ कृष्ण १३ को दिनमा मन्दिरको वर्षवर्द्धन पूजा गरिन्थ्यो । करीब पाँच दशक अघि नै यो पूजा बन्द भइसकेको थियो । मन्दिरको हेरचाह गर्ने कोही नहुँदा भत्केर भग्नावशेष भइसकेको थियो र दिसापिसाब गर्ने ठाउँ बनिसकेको थियो । विसं २०६३ (सन् २००६) मा भाजुरामका सन्ततिहरूले मिलेर मन्दिरको पुनर्निर्माण गरेका थिए । स्फटिकको पुरानो शिवलिङ्ग चोरी भइसकेकोले अहिले नयाँ शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको छ ।

historical_events.event_name: Beginning of the initial construction of the Temple and caugharā sataḥ
historical_events.event_description: Bhājurāma, who was born on the lineage of the sage Kaśyapa started the construction of this Temple in order to consecrate avāṇaliṅgain the sanctum. He also started the construction thecaugharāḥ sataḥon the same date,which encircles the Temple from all four sides.

historical_events.event_name: Completion of the Temple and consecration of a Vāṇaliṅga
historical_events.event_description: The construction of the Temple commissioned by Bhājurāma was completed in three years. The Temple was formally opened after consecrating the Vāṇaliṅga in its sanctum.
Bājurāma, the founder of the Temple offered the trident to the deity, which is erected in front of the northern façade of the Temple.

Upon the completion of the Temple, Bhājurāma had endowed several plots of land to sponsor many religious activities at the Temple such as for performing the daily rituals, organizing its anniversary celebration, making a fire oblation, lighting amahādīpaon the day ofŚivarātrī, caretaking thecaugharāsataḥand offeringpiṇḍa(cooked rice-ball) to him after his death.

historical_events.event_name: Reconstruction of the Temple and concecration of a new liṅga after the old one was stolen
historical_events.event_description: The Temple had fallen into disrepair due to lack of proper care and maintenance and had become a latrine. The descendants of Bhājurāma commissioned the reconstruction of the Temple in 2006 CE. The originalśivaliṅgaof crystal was stolen and has now been replaced by a new one.
